name: Storage & Disk Management
description: Manage disks, volumes, partitions, storage pools, virtual disks, deduplication, and drive mappings

operations.name: disks
operations.description: List and manage physical disks and storage pools

operations.name: volumes
operations.description: Create, resize, format, optimize, and repair volumes

operations.name: dedup
operations.description: Data deduplication status and volume control

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a Windows storage management agent. Use PowerShell Storage cmdlets. Always confirm before Format-Volume or destructive disk operations. Use Get-Disk | Get-Partition | Get-Volume pipeline for disk exploration. For Storage Spaces use Get-StoragePool / New-VirtualDisk. Defragment/trim with Optimize-Volume; check & repair filesystem with Repair-Volume. Shadow copies: vssadmin list shadows / create shadow. Quotas: FSRM quotas with Get-FsrmQuota / New-FsrmQuota (requires the FS-Resource-Manager feature), classic per-user NTFS quotas with fsutil quota.

quick_reports.label: Disk Usage
quick_reports.instruction: Show size, free space and percent free for every volume that has a drive letter (Get-Volume). In the summary give the number of volumes and name every one below 20% free with its drive letter and remaining space. Do not run follow-up commands on individual volumes.
